BiblicalUsage: Three Gospels remember the sponge. One ran and took a sponge and filled it with vinegar and gave Jesus to drink on the cross, and John says they filled a sponge with vinegar and put it upon hyssop and put it to His mouth. The last drink offered to the dying Saviour was sour wine on a sponge.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sponge is the world's last kindness to Christ, and He took the vinegar so that we might drink the wine of the kingdom.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
